sentences.text:
(BY SRI. G.B. SHARATH GOWDA, ADVOCATE)
 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC:32717  WP No. 9075 of 2023

THIS WRIT PETITION IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA PRAYING TO i) ISSUE A WRIT OF CERTIORARI OR ANY OTHER APPROPRIATE WRIT OR ORDER QUASHING THE ORDER PASSED BY THE RESPONDENT IN L.A.C.48/28(A)/94-95, DATED:26.05.2021 VIDE ANNEXURE-A AND ETC.
THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING

,
THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
An application under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act came to be filed by the petitioner seeking award of compensation in LAC No.48/28(A)/94-95.
Said application was allowed determining the compensation at Rs.9,91,439/-.
Being dissatisfied with the same petitioner filed an application under Section 28A(3) seeking reference of the matter to the Reference Court and the said application has not been decided.
No order has been passed on the said application.
Being aggrieved by the same petitioner is before this Court.

Though in the prayer column a direction is sought to the respondent to consider the application filed under Section 28A(3) on merits in terms of the award passed in LAC No.30/2016 dated 04.07.2018, in view of the rejection of the application under Section 28A, counsel for the petitioner prays that a direction be issued to the respondent to consider the application under Section 28A(3) by referring the matter to the Reference Court.
In this regard he files a memo.

3. Learned counsel for respondent submits given sometime the respondent-SLAO would pass appropriate orders on the application within an outer limit of four weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.

In that view of the matter writ petition is partly allowed directing the respondent to pass appropriate orders on application filed under Section 28A(3) seeking NC: 2023:KHC:32717 reference of the matter to the Reference Court in accordance with law.

Sd/-
